l.i: Celsitudinis Tuæ Zeli gloriam, & vel supremis titulis
prorogabit famam, quod tot fideles animas per cau-sam
nidis suis excussarum, hinc inde palantium, &
à mundo propter solam intemeratam in Jesum fidem pro
Tuæ sinu, excipis, foves, promoves, efficisque
denique, ut tot malis, quorum seriem formasque po-
steritas omnis stupebit, conflictantes, & jam pene
fractos non pœniteat, Patrios Lares tenerrime
aliàs dilectos, charitates, fortunas, quibus haud pœnitendis
multi abundaverant, denique cuncta, quæ caro
in delitiis habet, jactasse, solasque animas suas uni
Christo Domino suo sacratas pro spoliis retulisse. Quanta
ergo in Cœlis merces Munificentiæ huic, &,
quod majus est, veræ fidei erga Christum, & Charitatis
Te manebit! Quàm irrigua benedictionum Divinarum

page.notes: The Greek word σκυβάλοις is transcribed as printed. Some words in the lower lines are faint; "irrigua" and "Quàm" are read with some uncertainty. The running title is printed in spaced capitals and is not a page number.
